EXISTING_IMPLEMENTATIONS_REVIEWED.finding: run_round already consumes EngineAPI next-step packets, performs node-specific pre-research and L0.5/L7/report dispatch, and advances through existing controller commands. Its stage selection is currently embedded in the loop.
EngineAPI.next_step delegates to the existing lifecycle next-step authority, which selects the bound profile and returns the native v2.1 action packet, including the declared L9a then L9b order.
HypothesisLedger.snapshot_candidate returns the fixed candidate and round ledger cursor with finalized event references and projection hash; this is the authoritative v2.1 cursor source.
The compatibility profile and topology owners define native profile identity and node order; the runner can carry their next-step packet without maintaining another DAG or advance map.

The shared HostRequest/v1, immutable raw response receipt, request identity and v3-host RunReceipt boundary already provide transport and truthful host-session provenance for additional cognition stages.

persist_run() and its audit own literature/text persistence and currently validate headless command receipts; extend this receipt dispatch while preserving the command branch and existing persisted evidence.
These modules own native L4B/L8.5 evidence validation and provenance; host-generated assessments must return through these validators rather than create an alternate evidence authority.

The research command owns L7 execution-gate/workspace/script/output checks; run_loop owns REVIEW, StopPolicy and native node sequencing. Extend their existing host boundaries without changing execution or decision authority.

The actual interrupt()/Command source demonstrates checkpointed pause/resume and a typed continuation value. Its node resumes by re-executing node logic, so RLR reuses only the handoff concept and keeps exact committed-action recovery in its existing immutable request/receipt/checkpoint owners.

REUSABLE_COMPONENTS.reason: Extract the existing stage dispatch into a shared action projection and delegate deterministic actions to the same runner/controller owners.
Keep next-step as the only DAG/profile decision owner and carry its complete result into both execution modes.
Use the existing snapshot_candidate result for v2.1 cursor identity and fail closed when the caller's expected cursor is stale.
Preserve the native profile topology and serial L9a/L9b packet order without copying topology or advance mapping into the runner.
Carry every additional host cognition stage through the existing immutable request, raw response and truthful host receipt contract.
Add host receipt dispatch and preparation/submission seams at current persistence and evidence validation owners; preserve their existing scientific and provenance validators.
Route L7 and REVIEW through their current execution gate, delta and StopPolicy owners while the same runner remains the only loop controller.

WHY_NEW_CODE_IS_NECESSARY: The existing runner does not expose its current stage decision as a shared value, so an agent-native host cannot consume the same authorized action as headless execution. Extracting that projection and carrying the existing ledger cursor closes the seam while preserving next-step, ledger, and command owners.
